docs.title: About me
docs.text:
⏱ 3 min read

Hi, I'm Diogo, a software developer from Vila Nova de Famalicão, Portugal. I'm happiest when I'm learning something new, whether that's a language, a tool, or how a game I love was built.

docs.title: What I do
docs.text:
I'm a Software Developer at MVF Software, where I work on gym and sports management software. I started there in April 2025 as a six-month intern, and in October 2025 I joined the team full time.

My work covers the whole stack: server modules and databases, REST APIs and DataSnap services, data access with the Aurelius ORM, and the ViewModels and interfaces on top. I also connect the software to third-party APIs. On the team I help fix bugs and add new behaviour to the sports management system, and I work with management to get changes into production.

Two things I'm proud of there, both done on my own: the member self-service kiosk, designed and built from scratch, and the integration with AI and machine learning in the company's software.

docs.title: What I know
docs.text:
Programming: Delphi, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C#, C++, QML, Kotlin. Delphi is the one I use every day.

Tools: FireMonkey, DataSnap, Aurelius ORM, Firebird, SQL Server, MkDocs, Git, KNIME, Qt, Node.js.

AI: ChatGPT, Claude and prompt engineering.

Languages: Portuguese (native) and English (working knowledge).

docs.title: Outside work
docs.text:
Games are where I started, and I want to go back to them. I'm helping a friend make a game: designing levels, writing the story, coming up with new mechanics and drawing the world. Now I'm also starting to help with the code.

Music is always on, whether I'm coding, gaming or editing photos. I mostly listen to hip-hop and R&B, with The Weeknd way out in front. The Music page shows my listening stats, built from my own Spotify export with a Python script.

I photograph what catches my eye: streets, people and nature. My favourites are on the Photography page.

docs.title: What I'm looking for
docs.text: A bigger, international company where I can keep learning from experienced engineers, and build useful tools and automation.

docs.title: At MVF Software
docs.text:
2025 – now Member self-service kiosk

A touch kiosk where gym members sign up, choose a plan and pay on their own. I designed and built it from scratch, including the interface, the on-screen keyboard and the server side behind it.

Delphi · FireMonkey · DataSnap · Aurelius ORM

2025 – now AI and machine learning

My first project at MVF was integrating AI into the company's software. I also implemented the machine learning integration, both on my own.

AI · Machine learning · Python

2025 – now Gym management software

The product I work on every day: features across the full stack, third-party API integrations, and new versions as feedback comes in.

Delphi · REST APIs · Firebird
